subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode intentionally use reset-focused selection in the menu bar while Overview highest-usage ranking uses the maximum actionable quota lane?
rationale: Both behaviors are defensible, but they can display different percentages from the same snapshot and alter existing user expectations; repository intent is needed to make the contract stable.

options.title: Keep context-specific semantics
options.body: Use the earliest relevant reset for the automatic menu metric and maximum quota pressure for Overview, with focused tests and direct consumer proof.

options.title: Use one shared lane
options.body: Make menu-bar display and highest-usage ranking resolve the same Antigravity window to avoid differing percentages.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Leave current selection unchanged until representative exhausted and partially usable cases establish the product contract.

recommendation.title: Keep context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Use the earliest relevant reset for the automatic menu metric and maximum quota pressure for Overview, with focused tests and direct consumer proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a user-visible policy choice spanning two established product surfaces.
